name: A Day in the Life of a Slice of Bread
source: Have you ever wondered what it’s like to live life as a sentient slice of bread? Now’s your chance to find out. This is an extremely serious game, I recommend going to the closest convenience store and buying a box of tissues. Its emotional level will definitely be pulling a few heart strings. You’ve been warned.
translation: 你有没有想过，作为一片有知觉的面包来生活是什么感觉？现在你有机会找出答案。这是一个极其严肃的游戏，我建议去最近的便利店买一盒纸巾。它的情感水平肯定会牵动一些人的心弦。你已被警告过。
